pay_detail: Listed tuition $5,430, or $5,230 if you save before Jan 31. Housing $4,200. Scholarships exist (see the Scholarships link on the summer page).
duration: 5 weeks (listed dates July 9 to August 13; year not shown on the page)
name: Aspire: Five-Week Music Performance Intensive
org: Berklee College of Music Summer Programs
what_you_do: Five weeks of jam sessions, bands and one on one lessons with Berklee teachers on the Boston campus. Students come from many countries.
who_can_apply: Students age 15 and up, based on the age filter on the Berklee summer page. Check the program page for any playing experience needed.
deadline_text: The page lists a Jan 31 early-pay discount date. The application deadline is not stated on the page read.
how_to_apply: Use the Admissions and How to Enroll links on the Berklee summer programs page.
notes: Costs money. The year of the listed dates is not shown, so confirm dates, prices and any audition steps on the program page.
